messages:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout r2026-03-20-15 started for eu1/eu2/usw. eu1 at 40% traffic. automated quickchecks running: prefix-kv, embed-heat, liveness. posting quickcheck summary soon. :rocket:

alex: quickcheck snapshot – eu1 prefix-kv showing intermittent 503s between 08:23–08:26 UTC. p95 latency jumped 45ms -> 310ms for that window. no external alerts yet.

meera: confirmed in traces. kv-proxy returning 503 gateway to model-pool. curl probe to /internal/probe/prefix-kv is flapping 200/503 locally.

jon: kube events show a pod restart in variant b-v2 at 08:24 in eu1, OOM-ish footprint spike. stacktrace in logs points to slot-allocator changes.

nina: product: is this affecting customer traffic or only canary users?

deploy-bot: traffic split: canary/internal 20% only. stable routes unchanged. no customer-facing routing modifications yet.

alex: recommendation: pause rollout and pin eu1 back to r2026-03-19-22 (variant b-v1) while we root-cause. synth passes on pinned variant.

meera: +1. I'll flip routing fallback to b-v1 for eu1 and add a 5m extra warmup on the pinned pods.

jon: agree. also suggest raising kv-proxy circuit-breaker threshold and enable token bucket throttling to smooth burst.

deploy-bot: Hold placed — canary paused at 40%. initiating pin override: `/deploy pin eu1 r2026-03-19-22` requested by @meera.

ci-bot: Pin job queued: job/override-pin-eu1-3945678901 started. Logs: `pinning variant b-v1 -> draining new pods, routing new traffic to stable`. ETA ~90s.

meera: pin applied. rerunning synths: prefix-kv 10/10 OK, p95 back to ~48ms. kv-proxy restarts have stabilized.

alex: follow-ups: open a postdeploy incident note and delay rollout to remaining regions until RCA complete. add to release notes.

nina: product note: "EU canary paused due to backend proxy instability; pinned to previous model variant; no customer impact." Simple and visible in release log.

meera: action items: (1) investigate pod restarts / memory regression (owner: meera) (2) run targeted loadtest against kv-proxy with new slotting (owner: meera) (3) re-run canary with extended warmup and throttling (owner: jon). ETA: 2 hours for triage checkpoint.

jon: ack. prepping hotfix branch if slot allocator change is root cause.

alex: decision: hold rollout + pin eu1 for now. criteria to resume: p95 < 100ms and errors < 0.5% sustained for 30m in eu1.

deploy-bot: Noted and recorded. Thread placed in hold state. Ping @meera when RCA done. :white_check_mark:
